meta.title: ARNA: live voice translation, no language barriers
meta.description: ARNA translates speech live into ten languages. Follow events, videos, books and conversations in your own language, on your own phone. Join the pilot.

title: A world without language barriers.
Let’s grow together.
hero.subtitle: ARNA translates the speaker live into ten languages. Every listener hears it in their own language, on their own phone.

how.title: Four steps from the stage to your phone

steps.title: Join the event
steps.text: Scan the organizer's QR code or open the link.

steps.title: Choose a language
steps.text: Pick one of ten languages. You can switch at any moment.

steps.title: Confirm the voice
steps.text: ARNA recognizes the speaker's voice, so the translation always follows the right person.

steps.title: Listen and read
steps.text: Hear the translation, read the subtitles and get a short summary at the end.

items.name: Live
items.text: The speaker talks once, and every attendee follows the event in their own language, by audio or subtitles. When the session ends, everyone gets a short summary.

items.name: Network
items.text: Attendees meet and talk to each other, each in their own language. A language barrier no longer decides who gets to connect.

items.name: Video
items.text: Watch videos in your own language, with a translated voice or subtitles, whatever language they were made in.

items.name: Read
items.text: Listen to a book, an article or any text in your own language. ARNA reads it to you in a voice that is easy to follow.

items.name: Talk
items.text: Talk with a person who speaks another language. ARNA translates each phrase as you go, so the conversation keeps its pace.

demo.title: Try it right in your browser
demo.text: Walk through the listener's screen: choose a language, confirm the voice and follow the translation.
demo.notice: This is a scripted demonstration with prepared text. Real AI translation comes in the next phase.

cases.title: Who ARNA is for
cases.photoAlt: A speaker on stage in front of an audience lit by phone screens

items.title: Event organizers
items.text: Forums, congresses and event agencies. One stage, and every delegate hears it in their own language.

items.title: Schools and universities
items.text: Lectures, conferences and exchange programs where students and guest speakers use different languages.

items.title: Companies
items.text: International teams, partner meetings and trainings, without interpreters and without a shared language.

items.title: Individuals
items.text: Videos, books and texts in your own language, and conversations with people from anywhere in the world.
